ability_mae.description: Mean absolute error between the method-estimated ability and the evaluator-owned full-bank WLE target.

ability_se.description: Standard error of per-model ability absolute errors, penalizing unstable estimates across the evaluated model slice.

avg_items.description: Mean number of actually selected assessment items per evaluated model, computed from selected-item artifacts.

information_efficiency_score.description: Ability error times item usage normalized to the Random100 baseline within the same benchmark slice.

accuracy_mae.description: Mean absolute gap between p-IRT reconstructed accuracy and observed full-bank accuracy.

accuracy_se.description: Standard error of per-model p-IRT reconstructed accuracy absolute errors.

test_overlap_rate.description: Paper-defined exposure-probability test overlap rate, penalizing redundant selected test forms.

models_evaluated.description: Number of held-slice model identities for which the method produced evaluable artifacts.

average_item_exposure_rate.description: Average fraction of evaluated models exposed to each calibrated item, penalizing concentrated item reuse.
